Static IP Resource Delete Static IP
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/staticIP/:Id

Deletes the static IP address for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
Id
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the provisioned static IP address.

Responses
​
204

Successful Operation
